Community & society 2

Listen in on how Thai people talk about society and the problems it faces. This part digs into ปัญหาสังคม (social problems) — from ความเหลื่อมล้ำ (inequality) and คนไร้บ้าน (homeless people) to the rise of a สังคมผู้สูงอายุ (an ageing society). You'll hear the city-versus-country divide and its ชุมชนแออัด (crowded communities), the worry that people are growing more เห็นแก่ตัว (selfish), and how Thailand's faiths — including its มุสลิม (Muslim) communities — live side by side. All 29 sentences come with native-speed audio, English translations, and word-by-word notes, so the vocabulary sinks in by ear.
